_comment: Per-branch CI escalation rules. First matching rule wins. Patterns support * (no slash), **, ?, !negation and regex:<expr>. Fields: threshold, labels/addLabels, assignees/addAssignees, enabled. Validated by `bun run check:escalation`.

rules.name: production
rules.description: main is the release surface — escalate on the second red run.

rules.name: release-and-hotfix
rules.description: Release prep must never stay red.

rules.name: experiments
rules.description: Spikes are expected to be red; no triage issues.

rules.name: feature-branches
rules.description: Normal day-to-day work: give it three strikes.
